relationships.subject: Pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: high-voltage, long-duration PRF treatment increased spinal Nrf2 and HO-1 expression in a manner dependent on the treatment parameters

relationships.subject: Pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP content was reduced in the SCs of SNI rats, particularly in those that had undergone high-voltage, long-duration PRF treatment

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of bardoxolone methyl led to overexpression of Nrf2, which significantly downregulated CaMKII, p-CaMKII, and NF-κB p65 expression, and inhibited CGRP content in the spine of SNI rats

relationships.subject: KN-93
relationships.evidence_quote: After intrathecal KN-93 treatment, CaMKII and p-CaMKII expression were decreased in the SC of SNI rats compared to the DMSO control

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: CaMKII expression was decreased, regulating p-CaMKII expression downregulation and inhibiting CGRP expression in the SNI rats’ spine

key_findings: High-voltage, long-duration PRF relieves SNI mechanical hypersensitivity and raises spinal Nrf2/HO-1 while lowering CaMKII, NF-κB p65 and CGRP
Intrathecal Nrf2 activator, CaMKII inhibitor KN-93 and CGRP8-37 each reduce mechanical hypersensitivity in SNI rats
